text:
kai: Heads up, rack usw1-shelf-D2 showing pcie_uncorrectable spikes and HBM pressure. 95th latency creeping for multi-tenant pods. suspect noisy dense attention jobs.

meera: Seen it. shortlist nodes: usw1-d2-01, usw1-d2-04. Any dedicated reservations on those?

dave: d2-04 has one reserved slice (lotus_inc). avoid moving that. suggest trying per-alloc concurrency cap to 0.5 first.

kai: I'll apply concurrency cap and enable a temporary hbmlimit flag for top offender alloc-11021 for 5m.

ops-bot: applied: alloc-11021 concurrency=0.5, hbmlimit=true; trace=7070000000-trace. oncall notified (meera_sre).

meera: Also queue routing fallback to reserve slices in same region as second stage; TTL 20m, pre-warm 30s at 1% traffic. cost delta ~0.6%.

dave: If throttle+hbmlimit doesn't reduce pcie_err in 3m, we do a soft cordon on d2-01 only and evacuate non-dedicated pods. keep warm-pool target at 12%.

kai: monitoring. initial metrics: HBM_evictions down ~40% after 90s, pcie_uncorrectable down ~30%. holding on cordon.

meera: Good. follow-ups: infra#1910 (noisy-alloc auto-throttle) and infra#1911 (scheduler hint for reserve preference).

kai: thanks, closing thread when stable.
